children: Indonesia raised 34 trillion rupiah ($1.92 billion) from a regular bond auction on Tuesday, higher than the indicative target of 32 trillion rupiah, its finance ministry said.
Total incoming bids reached 60.97 trillion rupiah, lower than the 65.96 trillion rupiah in the previous auction on September 1.
